chunks: It is a decree imposed upon a town whose people We destroyed, that they will not return.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says it is 'imposed' upon a destroyed town that they will not return?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the finality of the 'barzakh' (intermediate realm) for those destroyed, distinguishing their permanent state from the temporary nature of the world. It highlights that divine punishment is not merely physical destruction but a definitive severance from the opportunity of repentance in this life, reinforcing the concept of 'ghayr raj' (non-return) as a sign of God's absolute decree.
